These issues directly violate the criteria for auto-approval and require human intervention to restore the logical flow and accessibility of the document.

Instead, it extracted the links and dumped them at the very end of the page content arrays, completely separating them from the paragraphs and lists they belong to. This materially impacts the logical flow for a screen reader user.
